title: Unconditional Single-Prover Classical Verification of BQP Computations
exact_target: Can a fully classical efficient verifier check arbitrary efficient quantum computations using one prover and unconditional security?

sources.citation: Mario Krenn, Formalize Open Quantum Problem \#49: Single-prover interactive proofs for quantum computations, google-deepmind/formal-conjectures issue 3466, opened 6 March 2026.
